author: reek
body: That is the whole point of this test. A core the hypervisor has created, configured and reported as started has still not necessarily run a single instruction of ours -- for a long time none of them had, and the host was quietly incrementing this counter on their behalf, which made a dead core look like a live one. The counter is honest evidence now, and reading back one less than the core count means every application processor is genuinely executing guest code.
